restrictions: Generic, distribution-free birthday attack; uses no structure of 32-round SHA-256 and produces no concrete collision.

The declared time_log2 uses the register memory model (per-instance hash cost 474/2224 = 0.213129 compression-units) plus index-permutation radix grouping (70/2224 = 0.031475 per record). Pessimistic per-operation load/store accounting gives per-instance hash cost 1736.75/2224 = 0.780913 and total time_log2 = 127.70, still below the prior generic bound 128.22.
Per-instance hash cost is a measured operation count read off ram.py's COUNTER for the SWAR-8 evaluator (proof.md Appendix A), bit-exact against reference_digest on 512 instances.
